title: 第11章 要注意自己安全切记不可冒进第12章 你是因我是果你的报应就是我
slug: 我被系统坑成了造物主
content_zh:
青鸳看到两人准备就绪，又检查了一遍，又拿出几瓶丹药备用，就随手一挥，灵石围绕两人一圈。
不一会两人阴阳合神功极速运转，一会气雾蒸腾，灵气向两人涌去。
半个时辰后，青儿丹海凝练完成，晋级筑基，恰在此时丹田中气海猛然爆动，青儿一个镇压力不及，真气逆流，吐出一口鲜血，姜云天大惊，正要将爆动的气海引度自身，却见一支碧绿的树桠带着几片绿叶向青儿的丹海探去，爆动的气旋瞬间平静，竞有半数被树桠吸收了。
有了树桠的镇压，青儿气血畅通，开始运功，姜云天也不敢怠慢，努力将自己的灵气过渡给青儿。
半个时辰后，青儿筑基稳固，达到一重，甚至达到了筑基一重巅峰。
大家都是松了一口气，却见那枝桠轻轻一抖，灵气又开始爆动起来，但却没有给青儿造成损伤，青儿快速开始运功，筑基一重、二重、三重、四重、五重、六重、七重，八重，九重下阶，才缓慢停止。
姜云天的阴阳气旋又震动了一下，一个小的阴阳图气旋被一震，从姜云天的丹田，飘到了青儿的丹田，停在了青儿的气海上空，慢慢旋转起来，将气海中的液体真气如龙卷风一般快速吸入气旋，又与姜云天丹田连接，吸入了姜云天的阴阳气旋。
这一幕，把姜云天都看愣了，心道“我尼玛，还能这样玩，你们自己玩，就当我不在
。”
半个时辰后，姜云天的阴阳气旋急速转动，丹田慢慢推出两个黑白色丹丸，比此前的稍小，飘浮在空中。
上次青鸳的阴阳果是树苗止长出来，这次的青儿这两个是阴阳气旋里出来的，但感觉差不多，姜云天心道“这路数我熟悉啊”
取出化神丹送入青儿口中，青儿服下不久，丹海中又开始爆动。
这种爆动与之前的不同，之前是无规则的，而这次却是全部涌向了气海上方的阴阳气旋，气旋又释放的这些更纯净的灵气又涌向灵体中的水灵根，墨色相互激荡，半个时辰后，水灵根中一道闪电闪过，一分为二，开始旋转，与上方的阴阳气旋相应成辉，同频转动，方向相反。
这把姜云天看的目瞪口呆。
心中赞道“我滴个乖乖，这么厉害的吗?，真是太让我吃惊了！
！”
碧绿的枝桠，抖落几滴灵液，悄然离开。”
姜云天想直接退出修练，可又担心别在最后阶段出现变故，忍着心中的不舒服，继续修练。
他对于枝桠那打个冷战，又抖几下的景象，深感侮辱。
他好生气，却很无力。

还好，不一会儿，青儿退出了修炼，修为竟然又进了一步，达到筑基九重巅峰。
她灿然一笑，一抬手，一条黑色年闪电在手上一闪而过。
却感觉不到雷电那种磅礴的力量，这道雷电让人感觉没有一点的威胁。
姜云天道“青儿，你手上的闪电是什么?”
“阴极神雷”
青儿笑颜如花。
这是个什么玩意儿，姜云天不知道，只能看向青鸳，等青鸳的解答。
青鸳快速地给他讲了什么叫阴极神雷。
听的姜云天冷汗直流。
阴极神雷，不是至刚至阳的天雷，也不是地脉中产生的，五行之中不会出现，据说只有在冥界才会诞生，是冥界大黑天和浸血之地万年无一的神雷。
它不主动攻击，也没有杀伤力，但它有个神奇的能力，只要附着到你的身上，你所在大陆以你为中心的方圆十万里以内的天雷就会集火攻击你。
阴极神雷，就像个美丽清纯的小妹妹，而你和她在一起，长得丑，你还玩的花，而周围一群荷尔蒙爆表的精神小伙，看到你像一只癞蛤蟆一样趴在清纯小妹妹的脚面上，你猜他们会不会集体爆打你，就是这么残忍。
你会说，我躲在秘境里，水里，钻土里，那么恭喜你，你会被水里的，土里的，山上的，火里的，树上的，这些地养的雷电或是雷火攻击，他们一击可能不会致命，但强在量多，走哪电哪，你会被电的最后你自己冲出秘境，哭着喊着让天雷爷爷们行行好，集火你，劈得你神魂俱灭，你才会心满意足。
有句话，叫阴雷一出，走狗满地。
什么意思，谁见谁怕，谁见谁跪。
姜云天一阵害怕，马上就问道“青儿，你收服它了吗？”
content_en:
When Qingyuan saw that the two were ready, he checked again and took out a few bottles of elixirs for later use. He waved his hand and the spiritual stones surrounded the two of them.
After a while, the two people's yin and yang combined magic skills were running at a high speed. After a while, the mist steamed, and the spiritual energy surged towards the two of them.
Half an hour later, Qing'er's Danhai was condensed and advanced to the foundation. At this moment, the Qi sea in the Dantian suddenly exploded. Qing'er was unable to suppress it, so his Qi flowed backwards and spat out a mouthful of blood. Jiang Yuntian was shocked. He was about to guide the explosive sea of ​​Qi to himself when he saw a green tree branch carrying a few green leaves towards Qing'er's Danhai. The explosive cyclone calmed down instantly, and half of it was absorbed by the tree tree.
With the suppression of Shuya, Qing'er's energy and blood flowed smoothly and he began to exercise his power. Jiang Yuntian did not dare to neglect and worked hard to transfer his spiritual energy to Qing'er.
Half an hour later, Qing'er's foundation building was stable, reaching the first level, and even reached the peak of the first level of foundation building.
Everyone breathed a sigh of relief, but then they saw the branch trembling slightly, and the spiritual energy began to explode again, but it did not cause any damage to Qing'er. Qing'er quickly started to exercise his skills, building the first level, the second level, the third level, the fourth level, the fifth level, the sixth level, the seventh level, the eighth level, and the ninth level before slowly stopping.
Jiang Yuntian's Yin-Yang cyclone shook again. A small Yin-Yang diagram cyclone was shaken. It floated from Jiang Yuntian's Dantian to Qing'er's Dantian, stopped above Qing'er's Qi sea, and slowly rotated, sucking the liquid Qi in the Qi sea into the cyclone quickly like a tornado, and then connected with Jiang Yuntian's Dantian, sucking in Jiang Yuntian's Yin-Yang cyclone.
Jiang Yuntian was stunned by this scene, and he thought to himself, "Damn it, I can still play like this. If you play by yourselves, just pretend that I'm not here."
. "
Half an hour later, Jiang Yuntian's yin and yang cyclone rotated rapidly, and his Dantian slowly pushed out two black and white pills, slightly smaller than the previous ones, floating in the air.
Last time, Qingyuan's Yin-Yang Fruit was a sapling that had stopped growing. This time, the two Qing'er came out of the Yin-Yang Cyclone, but they felt similar. Jiang Yuntian thought to himself, "I'm familiar with this road."
He took out the Transformation Pill and put it into Qing'er's mouth. Not long after Qing'er took it, the pill sea began to explode again.
This kind of explosion was different from the previous ones. It was irregular before, but this time it all rushed towards the Yin and Yang cyclone above the air sea. The purer spiritual energy released by the cyclone rushed towards the water spirit root in the spirit body. The black colors stirred up each other. Half an hour later, a lightning flashed in the water spirit root, split into two, and began to rotate. It glowed correspondingly with the Yin and Yang cyclone above, rotating at the same frequency and in the opposite direction.
Jiang Yuntian was stunned by this.
I praised in my heart, "Dear me, are you so powerful?" It really surprised me!
! "
The green branches shook off a few drops of spiritual liquid and left quietly. "
Jiang Yuntian wanted to quit training directly, but he was worried that something might happen in the final stage, so he endured the discomfort and continued training.
He was deeply insulted by the sight of the branches shivering and shaking a few times.
He was so angry, but powerless.
Fortunately, after a while, Qing'er quit practicing, and his cultivation actually improved a step further, reaching the peak of the ninth level of foundation building.
She smiled brilliantly, raised her hand, and a black bolt of lightning flashed across her hand.
But I couldn't feel the majestic power of thunder and lightning. This thunder and lightning made people feel no threat at all.
Jiang Yuntian said, "Qing'er, what is the lightning on your hand?"
"Cathode Thunder"
Qing'er's smile is like a flower.
Jiang Yuntian didn't know what this was, so he could only look at Qingyuan and wait for Qingyuan's answer.
Qingyuan quickly told him what the cathode thunder was.
Jiang Yuntian broke into a cold sweat after hearing this.
The Yin pole divine thunder is not the most powerful sky thunder, nor is it produced in the earth's veins. It will not appear in the five elements. It is said that it can only be born in the underworld. It is a divine thunder that is unique to the Mahakala and the blood-soaked land of the underworld for thousands of years.
It does not actively attack and has no lethality, but it has a magical ability. As long as it attaches to your body, it will destroy the continent you are on.The thunders within a radius of 100,000 miles with you as the center will focus their fire to attack you.
The cataclysmic thunder is like a beautiful and pure little sister, but you are ugly and playful with her, and a group of energetic young men with overflowing hormones around you see you lying on the pure little sister's feet like a toad. Do you think they will all beat you together? It's so cruel.
You will say, I am hiding in the secret realm, in the water, or in the earth, then congratulations, you will be attacked by thunder and lightning or thunder and fire in the water, in the earth, on the mountain, in the fire, on the tree, these earth-raised thunder and lightning, they can attack with one blow Whether it can be fatal or not, but the strength lies in the quantity. Wherever you go, you will be shocked. Finally, you rush out of the secret realm by yourself, crying and shouting for the grandfathers of Tianlei to do well, focus on you, and chop you to death. Only then will you be satisfied.
There is a saying that when thunder comes out, the ground will be full of lackeys.
What do you mean? Whoever sees you will be afraid, and whoever sees you will kneel down.
Jiang Yuntian was frightened for a while, and immediately asked, "Qing'er, have you subdued it?"
